$comment: ADR-059 time-boxed audit exemptions. Read by scripts/audit-exemptions.js, which CI and tests/regression/sprint-75-security-gate.test.ts both call. Rules: exact package + GHSA id (no wildcards), high severity only (critical is never exemptible), every field required, expiry at most 7 days after creation. The gate FAILS on a malformed, expired, or unmatched entry — an exemption that no longer matches a live advisory means upstream shipped a fix and it must be deleted.

exemptions.rationale: Re-measured upstream on 2026-08-11: image-size latest remains 2.0.2 (the advisory range is <=2.0.2, so every published version is affected); metro newest remains 0.87.0 and still declares image-size ^1.0.2, so upgrading metro does not help. image-size 2.x drops the default export metro/src/Assets.js requires. Reach is apps/mobile -> expo@57 -> @expo/metro -> metro, a dev-time bundler that ships in no deployed image.

Re-measured upstream on 2026-08-11: image-size latest remains 2.0.2 (the advisory range is <=2.0.2, so no fixed release exists); metro newest remains 0.87.0 and still declares image-size ^1.0.2. This second advisory covers the JXL/HEIF parsers and remains listed separately: exemptions match an exact advisory id, never a package wildcard, so a third image-size advisory would still block the gate.
